title: Immunogenicity and Safety of a Booster Dose of Monovalent Glycoprotein-Conjugated (Diptheria Toxin -CRM197) Hib Vaccine in 365-569 Days Old Healthy Infants
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of booster dose of two commercially available vaccines used to prevent Haemophilus influenzae type b infections in children 365-569 days of age
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants 365-569 days of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who already received a booster dose of Hib vaccine.
* History of serious reaction(s) following vaccination.
* Any vaccination within 7 days of study vaccination.
* Known or suspected immune impairment.
